evidence.fact: Decompilation exposes the outer 0x9a1552d3, kMsgComponentActivated, and 0x1c routes plus the subcommand decision tree.
All 295 instructions, 17 named direct callees, signed JG/JZ branch order, RET 0x8 exits, and vtable offsets are taken from the executable listing.
No direct code caller exists; dispatch is through the data vtable entry at 0x013f92d8.
The sole xref is DATA at 0x013f92d8.
Live Ghidra still reports no recovered parameters, so the SDK signature and live stack/RET evidence are preserved explicitly.
The target references App::sPreferencesPropList at 0x015fd91c and DAT_00dbdba1 at 0x00dbdba1; neither global is typed or fully documented.
The target has zero string references; PlayMode exists at 0x013fea48 but is not directly referenced by the function.
EditorUI construction and destruction install 0x013f92c0 into the subobject at +0x04.
SDK identifies the owner, HandleMessage signature, 0x12c size, and fields at +0x58/+0x70/+0x7c/+0x108/+0x10c.
SDK confirms source at +0x00, eventType at +0x08, and the event union beginning at +0x0c.
0x005dd750 is called with the query object in ECX and a separate Property* value pointer pushed on the stack; App::sPreferencesPropList is not the stack argument.
0x0093db80 is called with query in ECX and an explicit zero stack argument before its RET 4.
The primary +0x28 result is transformed once into saved_flag=(result>>1)&1; the final +0x7c call reloads that saved byte from [ESP+0x24] and passes it with command 0x10.

The producer hash 0x70218642 occurs in 0x0057c2f0, 0x005dcf90, and 0x005de690, while 0xb006ef6e and 0xf006efa5 occur in dedicated producer/control helpers; the target-local signed range still prevents 0x70218642 from reaching mode 2.
